projects.title: Retail Margin Cockpit

projects.longDescription: dbt and SQL analytics layer that reconciles dispatch, route, timesheet and fuel data into true cost-to-serve per job and route, and shows where SLA breaches concentrate.

projects.title: Personal Finance Database
